title: Find the last names of regular club members who attended the event with the
question: Find the last names of regular club members who attended the event with the highest attendance and who also have a t-shirt size of 'Large'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m.XCL_036
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_038 = 'Member'
  AND m.XCL_039 = 'Large'
  AND a.XCL_001 = (
    SELECT a2.XCL_001
    FROM attendance AS a2
    GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
    ORDER BY COUNT(a2.XCL_001) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
